==Description==
'''Nuclear''' is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that increases all currency rewards by 30%.

'''Nuclear''' appears exclusively in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]; it is active in all matches on that map.

==Effects==
Previously, this modifier used to affect the health of multiple enemies and replaced multiple enemies that appeared on this map with their nuclear variants. However, as time went on, this functionality was slowly replaced by other parts of the game, until it has been replaced completely. Currently, its only purpose is to boost the rewards given by the map.

Prior to [[Polluted Wasteland II]] being moved to the [[Challenge Maps]] system, it replaced the following enemies<ref name="challenge">These changes still persist in [[Polluted Wasteland II]] due to them being tied to its challenge.</ref>:
*The [[Wastewalker|Mutated]] used to replace the [[Abnormal]].
*The [[Wasterunner|Mutated Speedy]] used to replace the [[Quick]].
*The [[Hazardous|Polluted Hazmat]] used to replace the [[Heavy]].
*The [[Super Mutant|Mutated Boss]] used to replace the [[Abnormal Boss]].
*The [[Amalgamation]] used to replace the [[Giant Boss]].
**The [[Amalgamation]] also spawned [[Fleshling]]s when damaged.
*The [[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]] used to replace the [[Glitch]] and the [[Error]].
*The [[Rusher]] used to replace the [[Hazard]].
*The [[Abomination]] used to replace the [[Tank]].
*The [[Super Slime|Radioactive Slime]] used to replace the [[Boomer]].
**The [[Super Slime|Radioactive Slime]] also spawned [[Goo]]s upon death.
*The [[Super Toxic]] used to replace the [[Fallen Hero]].
*The [[Nuclear Guardian]] used to replace the [[Fallen Guardian]].
*The [[Nuclear Monster]] used to replace the [[Fallen King]].

The modifier also used to replace more enemies before the [[v1.4.2|Halloween 2022 Update]]<ref name="challenge"/>:
*The [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] used to replace the [[Dark Necromancer]].
**The [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] also spawned [[Skeleton]]s with its ''Summon'' ability.
*The [[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]] used to replace the [[Templar]].
*The [[Necromancer King|Necromancer Boss]] used to replace the [[Summoner Boss]].
**The [[Necromancer King|Necromancer Boss]] also spawned [[Cursed Skeleton]]s with its ''Cursed Summon'' ability.
